answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a dawn-to-dusk probation of verified useful work: random peers assign small tasks and check the results, like cedar roots gripping only where the soil holds. A single honest agent pays one deposit and one probation; a Sybil farmer launching a comet swarm of fakes must fund and babysit every identity through the same slow probation, so cost scales linearly with each fake while the network gains verified work.
